instruction: Extract every function and class definition from the notebook's code cells, merge them into 'definitions.py', and store the file in the Home folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting ONLY function and class definitions from Colab code cells (excluding imports, variables, print statements, etc.). Evaluator uses AST parsing to check: (1) File exists with content (0.2), (2) Contains at least one function or class definition (0.3), (3) Contains ONLY definitions at top level, no other code (0.3), (4) Bonus for containing both types (0.2). This ensures proper extraction quality and exclusion of non-definition code.

llm_judge_reasons: Robust AST-based verification: Uses ast.parse() to properly parse Python file structure, not regex pattern matching

Complete coverage of instruction requirements: Checks (1) file exists with content, (2) contains definitions, (3) ONLY contains definitions (no imports/variables/print statements), (4) bonus for both function and class definitions
Correct scoring logic: Properly awards 0.2 bonus only when BOTH has_def and has_class are true (line 69), fixing previous scoring bug
Proper exclusion verification: Lines 53-66 verify top-level statements are ONLY FunctionDef/ClassDef/AsyncFunctionDef, with partial penalty (0.1 instead of 0.3) if non-definition code is present
Good error handling: Handles None result, syntax errors, and logs non-definition code types found
